data.case_title: Use prohibition for basement room (Nutzungsuntersagung Kellerraum)
data.title: Use prohibition for the basement room at Lennestraße 41 (Nutzungsuntersagung)
data.summary: The city of Beispielhagen's building authority (Bauordnung) issued a use prohibition (Nutzungsuntersagung) dated 18 November 2026, forbidding Ilka Musterlenne from renting out the basement room at Lennestraße 41 as living space because it lacks adequate windows and a second escape route. A lawsuit (Klage) can be filed with the Administrative Court within one month of notification; no objection (Widerspruch) procedure applies.
data.explanation: This letter from the local building authority (Bauordnung) tells you that you may no longer rent out your basement room as a home, because it does not meet safety standards for windows and escape routes. If you disagree, you may file a lawsuit (Klage) directly with the Administrative Court (Verwaltungsgericht) in Musterarnsberg — there is no preliminary objection (Widerspruch) step here. The app will show you until when this is possible. If you take no action within that window, the prohibition becomes final and you must stop using or renting out the room as living space. Consider consulting a lawyer specialising in building law if you wish to contest this.
